prompt: Create an original 90 second instrumental post-rock instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: clean electric guitars, electric bass, live drums. Style: delay guitar figures and patient layered crescendos. Tempo approximately 100 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: An upbeat and groovy instrumental track featuring electric guitar, bass, and drums. The guitar plays a catchy melody over a solid rhythm section, creating a funky rock feel.
description.zh: 一首欢快且律动感十足的纯音乐曲目，由电吉他、贝斯和鼓组成。吉他演奏着抓耳的旋律，配合扎实的节奏部分，营造出放克摇滚的氛围。
